up: Retrieve distinct `molecule_chembl_id` (sourced from `molecule_dictionary.chembl_id`), `pref_name`, `canonical_smiles`, `max_phase`, and `first_approval`. Filter results to only include molecules where `max_phase` is 3 or 4. Enforce an INNER JOIN between `molecule_dictionary` and `compound_records` to ensure each returned molecule has at least one compound record. Use a LEFT JOIN for `compound_structures` to fetch `canonical_smiles`, allowing molecules without structures to remain in the results. Return exactly the specified columns with no additional fields.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
    md.pref_name,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    md.max_phase,
    md.first_approval
FROM molecule_dictionary md
INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON md.molregno = cr.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE md.max_phase IN (3, 4)
